messages:
mira: Quick planning note: Enterprise team asked for a narrow observability demo—must show per-route cost slices, an error-analytics lens, and a way to pull traces for long-tail latency. We have 3 weeks. Can we agree a minimal, ship-ready slice?

alex: keep scope tight. Proposal: (A) cost-slice widget (top 50 routes, p50/p95 cost, CSV export), (B) error lens (overlay p95+error-rate+cost-per-call), (C) trace-filter link that pre-fills timeframe and model_version for sampled spans.

jen: acceptance criteria for demo: cost CSV includes route_id + model_version column for top routes; error lens highlights correlated windows; trace link opens filtered view and returns >=30 sampled traces on synthetic spike.

dan: runtime note: model_version on every span is heavy. MVP: attach model_version to sampled spans only and expose enterprise override sampling. Need exporter caps.

sam: UX quick-win: a "capture for 30m" button on route detail so support can temporarily bump sampling for an investigation. Low effort, big demo impact.

abby: infra gating: if sampling ramps during canary, exporter QPS must stay under budget. Gate: dropped-span-rate < 1% and storage-growth < 12% during a 1h synthetic spike.

mira: estimates (thin scope): cost widget + CSV = 5 dev-days; sampled trace attr + sampling flags = 7 dev-days; error lens prototype = 3 dev-days; capture button + docs = 2 dev-days. Total ~3 weeks across owners.

alex: config snippet for demo we can ship:
```
tracing:
  default_sample: 0.05
  enterprise_overrides:
    AcmeHealth: 0.25
  attach_attrs: ["model_version","routing_policy"]
  capture_button_duration_sec: 1800
```

jen: privacy note: redact prompt content by default. Enterprise opt-in flow for full capture + KMS checklist in runbook. Add a demo README marking data as synthetic.

mira: action owners & dates:
- alex: implement cost-slice widget + CSV export (owner) - due 2025-07-18
- dan: sampled span attr + sampling flag in runtime (owner) - due 2025-07-15
- abby: exporter rate-limit + canary plan (owner) - due 2025-07-16
- sam: capture button + demo traffic + README (owner) - due 2025-07-14
- jen: draft acceptance criteria + runbook (owner) - due 2025-07-12

ops-bot: reminder: observability-standup tomorrow 10:00

mira: please react with :white_check_mark: when you own and :eyes: if you're just reviewing. We'll prioritize demo fidelity over broader rollout if we hit perf issues.
